suggested_params.rationale: Strategy is unprofitable (PF 0.92, -8R over 120 trades) with low 45% win rate. Three main issues: (1) Trading 1/3/5min simultaneously creates signal conflicts and noise—consolidate to single 5min for cleaner divergence resolution. (2) Bare RSI+divergence produces too many false signals; add volume (confirm bullish/bearish divergence with volume expansion) and EMA (trade only with trend, not counter-trend) as filters to lift win rate toward 55%+. (3) Need asymmetric R-multiples—widening to [1,2,3,5,7] lets winners run to capture full divergence moves (typical 3-7R swings) while tighter stops improve R:R. Reducing weight to 0.6 reflects current underperformance and prevents capital from flowing to a losing strategy until filters are validated. Expectancy math: with 55% WR and 2.5R avg win vs 1R stop, PF target = (0.55*2.5)/(0.45*1) = 3.06.
